references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.5 and Social Security Act B.E. 2533 (1990) s.5: a fixed allowance paid every month for work in normal time is wage, so it enters the SSO and WCF bases; employment income under Revenue Code s.40(1).

name: Benefit in kind (housing, car, employer-paid tax)

references.title: Revenue Code ss.39, 40(1): income from employment includes money's worth and "other benefits" the employer provides — free housing, a car, and the income tax the employer pays for the employee. The monthly value (and for borne tax, the tax borne) enters the PND1 base without being paid; not SSO or WCF wage. The gross-up of a borne tax repeats by the next month's amount.

name: Piece-work wages

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.5 ("wage" includes money paid by the piece of work), s.70(1): a piece worker is paid at least monthly for the units of normal time (contract fact piece_rate, roster day fact units); units on a holiday are HOLIDAY_WORK and overtime units OVERTIME. Wage for SSO, WCF, PND1, PVD and EWF (SSA s.5, WCA s.5). Office of the Council of State English translation

eligibility:
(has(terms.facts.pay_basis) && terms.facts.pay_basis == "PIECE")
&&sum(
  work.days.filter(d, !(d.holiday_kind != "" || d.day_type == "REST")).map(
    d,
    (has(d.facts) && d.facts != null && has(d.facts.units)
      ?double(d.facts.units)
      :0.0
  ) )
)
>0.0
amount:
(sum(
  work.days.filter(d, !(d.holiday_kind != "" || d.day_type == "REST")).map(
    d,
    (has(d.facts) && d.facts != null && has(d.facts.units)
      ?double(d.facts.units)
      :0.0
  ) )
))
* ((has(terms.facts.piece_rate) ? double(terms.facts.piece_rate) : 0.0))
